method: Conservative equal-weight completion of planned automatic tasks in89allowlisted PLANs. Excludes2decision checkpoints. C=complete scoped deliverable with recorded local verification, P=partial and zero numerator credit, U=no complete implementation receipt found. Independent receipts are linked separately. This is not effort/LOC/product readiness. Admission of a PLAN does not authorize every gated task. Diagnostic/documentation tasks count where they are the actual deliverable. Historical overlapping/ancestor task slots remain until explicit reconciliation; no weighted overall feature-completion claim. Reassessment preserves original229-task denominator and all prior complete credits, unless concrete reversal proven. Fresh evidence is local-source/retained-log review plus six targeted built-in reruns, not an independent rerun of every newly claimed runtime test. 2026-09-12 ERP scope excluded. Resumed implementation adds fresh hosted native qualification, independent source review and exact release receipts for three scoped tasks; same229-task denominator retained. New audit findings and generated follow-ups are disclosed outside this historical metric.
